brand_identity.name: SynapseEDU / StudentSOS 2.0
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Intelligent, focused, professional, premium, trustworthy. It should feel like a high-end academic tool that genuinely understands the user's weaknesses.
brand_identity.core_differentiator: Visible learning loop, measurable mastery, pinpointing weaknesses.

rules: Never use default Bootstrap fonts for headings. Always import Outfit and IBM Plex Sans.
Headings must have tight letter spacing.
Use uppercase with wide tracking (0.1em) for tiny labels and overlines (e.g., 'WEAKEST TOPIC').

usage.backgrounds: Use --bs-body-bg (#F8FAFC) for the app canvas/dashboard background to reduce eye strain. Use --synapse-surface for cards and sidebar.
usage.text: Deep slate (#0F172A) for high contrast. Never pure black.
usage.accents: Use Primary (#1D4ED8) for interactive elements. Use AI Accent (#8B5CF6) sparingly for AI-generated insights or 'AI Processing' states.
usage.mastery_indicators: Strictly map High (>80%) to Emerald, Med (50-79%) to Amber, Low (<50%) to Red to create an immediate visual read of weaknesses.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Use Bootstrap's CSS Grid or flex-based row/col system, but with generous gaps (gap-4 or gap-5).
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed width, approx 260px. Minimalist, uncluttered. Highlight active states with a subtle left-border or light primary background tint.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Padding must be generous. Use p-4 (1.5rem) or p-5 (2rem) inside cards. Never cramp text.
spacing_and_layout.container: Use fluid containers (.container-fluid) for the dashboard, max-width bounded to 1600px for ultra-wide screens.

ui_components.cards: Background pure white. Border 1px solid var(--synapse-border). Box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Border-radius: 12px (0.75rem). Hover state: slightly elevate (transform: translateY(-2px)) and increase shadow (0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)). NO default Bootstrap thick borders.
ui_components.buttons: Primary buttons: Pill-shaped (border-radius: 50px) or slightly rounded (border-radius: 8px). Smooth background color transition on hover.

progress_and_mastery.circular: Use SVG radial progress bars for overarching mastery percentages. Animate the stroke-dashoffset.
progress_and_mastery.linear: Custom styled Bootstrap .progress. Height 8px, border-radius 10px, background #E2E8F0. Fill color depends on mastery level.

ui_components.ai_tutor_chat: Clean, distinct bubbles. User: solid primary background, white text. AI: light gray/blue background (--bs-body-bg), dark text, with a subtle 'AI' icon. Include inline source citations (e.g., '[Source: OSI Model PDF, pg 3]') styled as small badge links.
ui_components.upload_zone: Dashed border (2px dashed #CBD5E1), light background. Hover state shifts border to primary color. Add a GSAP pulse animation during 'AI Processing'.

motion_and_gsap.philosophy: Fast, smooth, professional, purposeful. No bouncy gamification.
motion_and_gsap.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up for main content. gsap.from('.page-content', { opacity: 0, y: 15, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' });
motion_and_gsap.dashboard_cards: Staggered entrance. gsap.from('.bento-card', { opacity: 0, y: 20, duration: 0.6, stagger: 0.05, ease: 'power3.out' });
motion_and_gsap.mastery_animations: Draw SVG circles on scroll/load. gsap.to('.mastery-path', { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power3.inOut' });
motion_and_gsap.upload_processing: When a file is dropped, show a sleek scanning line over the document icon, followed by a sequential reveal of 'Topics Found' using GSAP stagger.
motion_and_gsap.quiz_transitions: Fade out old question, slide in new question from right. duration: 0.4.

image_urls.description: Abstract computer network nodes (blue). Use as a subtle overlay/background for the 'Current Subject: Computer Networks' hero banner in the dashboard.
Young student portrait using laptop. Use for the Login page background or as the User Profile Avatar placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL TECH STACK OVERRIDE: The system environment might mention React/Tailwind, but YOU MUST BUILD THIS USING PLAIN HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, and GSAP. DO NOT initialize a React app. DO NOT use Tailwind CSS classes.
CSS Architecture: Create custom CSS variables in the :root scope overriding standard Bootstrap 5 variables. Write custom CSS for the dashboard layout, cards, and animations.

GSAP Integration: Include GSAP via CDN in the HTML <head>. Write a dedicated JS file (e.g., app.js) to handle DOM manipulations, data mocking (for Computer Networks demo content), and GSAP animations.
Navigation: Implement a persistent left sidebar. The active state must be visually distinct.

Data Mocking: Mock the 'Computer Networks' subject. Include topics like OSI Model, TCP/IP, AIMD Algorithm. Show different mastery levels (e.g., OSI Model: 90%, AIMD: 35%). Flag AIMD as the 'Weakest Topic' that needs revision.
Testing Attributes: Ensure all buttons, forms, and major links have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='start-quiz-btn').

Avoid generic 'Upload PDF' feel: The UI must clearly display the Learning Loop (Upload -> Processing -> Topic Extraction -> Mastery Tracking). Use the provided layout and typography to enforce a premium, institutional SaaS feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Use the defined --bs-body-color on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Custom focus rings for inputs and buttons (e.g., 2px solid var(--bs-primary) with an outline-offset of 2px).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-valuenow on custom progress bars, and aria-live='polite' on the AI Tutor responses.
